segments.name: community banking
segments.description: Community banking segment provides relationship-driven lending and deposit services to small and medium-sized businesses, municipalities and retail clients.
segments.evidence: Accordingly, all of the community banking services and branch locations are considered by management to be aggregated into one reportable operating segment, community banking.

revenueModel.text: Individuals, businesses and municipalities pay interest and fees for deposits, loans, treasury management, mortgage origination and insurance services.
revenueModel.evidence: Our offerings include traditional retail deposits, treasury management, commercial deposits, commercial and consumer loans, mortgage origination, insurance, mobile banking and online banking.
